summary: Part 1 of Shared.js holds the cross-board helpers: HTML/attribute escaping and URL sanitising, an allow-list rich-text sanitizer (used to render every forum/board comment), Quill rich-text composer wrappers keyed `board-richtext-comment-<cardIdentifier>`, and the comment edit/reply state machines (edit own comment, reply-to with a collapsible 'Replying to' preview, shared action bar with Post Comment / Update Comment / Post Reply / Cancel). The second half is the data layer and HTML builders for the Account Inspector (opened by clicking any name/address chip): identity resolution (name -> owner address -> registered names), sponsorship info with /sponsor fallback, paged transaction history (200 per page with Load more / Load all TX), first-transaction date, MINTER group (694) membership plus kicked/banned history, asset balances, and per-transaction detail hydration (transfer flow From/Amount/To, group transactions, DEPLOY_AT ACCT sell orders via /at/<address>). No QDN resource is read or written in this chunk and no transaction is built; all network calls are plain Core REST fetches via qFetchBoardJson/searchTransactions, each memoised in module-level Maps for the session. The only identifier constant here is `Q-Mintership-blockedNames` (BLOG_POST), whose read/write live in part 2 (lines 4249-4363). Efficiency hot spots: names/address and asset balances use limit=0, and the MINTER status check triggers fetchAllKickBanTxData (two limit=0 GROUP_KICK/GROUP_BAN searches, 60s cache) per inspector open.

features.description: All board/forum comment bodies and rich content are run through qSanitizeRichHtml (allow-list: A B BLOCKQUOTE BR CODE DIV EM H1-H6 I LI OL P PRE S SPAN STRONG U UL; attrs class/dir on any tag, href/target/rel on A, data-* anywhere; on*/style stripped; dangerous tags removed; links forced rel=noopener noreferrer, target only _blank; href sanitised to qortal://, #, /, ./, ../, http(s), mailto). Plain text (no tags) is HTML-escaped instead.

Each card gets a Quill 'snow' editor (id board-richtext-comment-<cardIdentifier>) with toolbar: header H2/H3, bold, italic, bullet list, clean; formats limited to header/bold/italic/list. Falls back to a plain contenteditable div when Quill is absent. Output HTML is sanitised before publishing; empty text yields empty HTML.

Pencil button (mobi-mbri-edit-2, title 'Edit comment') on a comment. Allowed only when the current account name equals the publisher name (case-insensitive) or the publisher name resolves to the current address. Loads the cached comment HTML into the card composer, sets submit label 'Update Comment', shows 'Cancel Edit', status 'Editing comment by <name>.', opens and scrolls to the comments section, focuses the editor at the end.

Reply button (mobi-mbri-redo, title 'Reply to comment') on a comment. Captures publisher, timestamp text and body HTML from the DOM/cache, switches the card composer to reply mode: placeholder 'Write a reply...', submit label 'Post Reply', 'Cancel Reply' button, status 'Replying to <name>.', and a composer-variant reply preview.

Embedded preview block: kicker 'Replying to', clickable author chip (opens Account Inspector), timestamp label (toLocaleString), collapsible original content (default collapsed, arrow-down/arrow-up toggle with aria-expanded; 'Original comment unavailable.' when content missing). Content cached per comment identifier via rememberBoardCommentContent/Data.

Per-card action bar with aria-live status, reply preview slot, submit button (default handler postComment, label Post Comment / Update Comment / Post Reply) and a hidden cancel button (Cancel Edit / Cancel Reply). Cancelling clears both edit and reply state and empties the editor.

buildBoardAccountTriggerHtml renders a button or keyboard-accessible span with data-account-name/data-account-address that opens the Account Inspector (openBoardAccountInspectorFromElement, part 2). Used for comment authors, reply authors, transaction parties and group owners.

Resolves a name or Q-address (regex ^Q[a-zA-Z0-9]{33}$) to {address, displayName, resolvedName, registeredNames[]}: name -> /names/<name>.owner; address -> /names/address list. Display name prefers the resolved name, then the typed name, then the first registered name, then the address; 'Unknown' when nothing resolves.
Shows /addresses/sponsorship data for the address; if the record is empty it falls back to the sponsor-side view (/sponsor) and flags usedFallback/sourceType ('sponsorship' | 'sponsor' | 'none').

features.feature: Account Inspector: transaction history with Load more / Load all TX
features.description: Pages of 200 transactions (confirmed + unconfirmed, newest first). Top controls show a warning paragraph ('Load all transaction history may take a long time...') plus 'Load more' and 'Load all TX' buttons; labels switch to 'Loading more...' / 'Loading all...' and both are disabled while busy or when no more pages. Controls are hidden when there is nothing more to load.
Fetches the oldest transaction to display the first-activity date (toLocaleString); reports loaded/error states.
Grid of transaction types with counts from the loaded pages, ARBITRARY pinned first (highlighted row), then by count desc then name; empty state 'No transaction history loaded yet.'

features.feature: Account Inspector: MINTER group status badge data
features.description: Determines isInMinterGroup (member of groupId 694 or a group named 'minter'), previouslyKicked (final GROUP_KICK with groupId 694 and member === address) and previouslyBanned (final GROUP_BAN with groupId 694 and offender === address), hasHistory, currentGroup.
Lazy-loaded list of non-zero asset balances for the address, QORT (assetId 0) first then alphabetical; state flags assetBalancesExpanded/Loaded/Loading/Error.

features.feature: Account Inspector: transfer flow detail (From -> Amount -> To)
features.description: For transactions with a sender and recipient (or a single-recipient multi-payment, summed), shows two party panels (role label, up to 3 registered-name chips plus '+N more', clickable address chip, 'No registered names found.' / 'Unknown address.' empty states) around an amount panel with '<n> payments' note; hydrated lazily per row with 'Loading linked names...'. 8-decimal BigInt amount formatting.

For GROUP_INVITE / JOIN_GROUP / GROUP_BAN / GROUP_KICK / LEAVE_GROUP rows: action label (e.g. 'Group Invite'), group name (or 'Group <id>' / 'Unknown group'), owner chip (clickable) or 'Unknown owner.', and 'Group ID: <id>'.

For DEPLOY_AT rows whose name contains 'ACCT': summary chips SELL / Amount / Market (name with 'ACCT' stripped) / status; expanded banner plus meta grid (AT Address, Creation, Version, Asset ID, Creator public key, Code hash, Finished, Sleeping, Frozen, Fatal error) and note 'isFinished: true means the sell order has completed.' Status labels: Unavailable, Failed, Completed, Frozen, Sleeping, Running (plus 'Loading details...'). Error state 'Unable to load AT details for this sell order.'

clearQMintershipBodyContent removes body children matching the Mobirise section selectors (.features7, .features1, .footer1, .forum-main, .minter-board-main, .add-remove-admin-main, .stats-board-main, .tools-main) when a board mounts; qMintershipActiveBoard tracks the active board ('forum' default).
getEffectiveMinterAdminMembers/Count filter the admin list to non-empty members excluding the null address (QdSnUy6sUiEnaN87dWmE92g1uQjrvPgrWG), used for admin-threshold maths elsewhere.

bugs.description: Inline handlers `onclick="postComment('<cardIdentifier>')"` and `clearBoardCommentEditState('<cardIdentifier>')` are built with qEscapeAttr, which turns `'` into `'`; the browser decodes that entity back to `'` before evaluating the JS, so a card identifier containing a quote (publisher-controlled QDN identifier) breaks out of the string literal and can execute script. Escape for JS (or use data attributes + addEventListener) instead.

getBoardAccountMinterGroupStatus calls fetchAllKickBanTxData, which runs two limit=0 /transactions/search calls (all GROUP_KICK and all GROUP_BAN since block 1990000) just to check one address; with a 60s cache this is repeated on nearly every Account Inspector open and grows with chain history.

getBoardNamesForAddress requests /names/address/<addr>?limit=0 (unlimited) and getBoardAccountAssetBalances requests /assets/balances?...&limit=0; both violate the no-unlimited rule, though result sizes are usually small.
MINTER membership matches any group whose name lower-cases to 'minter' in addition to groupId 694; a different group registered with that name would produce a false 'in MINTER group' status.
getBoardGroupInfo and getBoardAtInfo cache `null` for the whole session on any error (including transient network failures), so group names / AT status stay 'Unknown' until reload.

getBoardAccountFirstTransactionInfo calls searchTransactions unguarded (no typeof check) unlike getBoardAccountTransactions; if QortalApi.js failed to load the promise rejects and the cache entry is deleted, but the returned object reports loaded:false, error:true and the UI has no retry.

openBoardCommentReplyFromElement reads the publisher name and body from the rendered DOM (`.comment-meta` text, `.comment-body` innerHTML) in preference to cached data; if the body already contains an embedded reply preview, the captured HTML nests preview inside preview, and a display label that differs from the registered name is stored as publisherName.
Dead ternary `cached && typeof cached.then === 'function' ? cached : cached` returns the same value on both branches (intended promise de-dup is already achieved by storing the promise).

qSanitizeRichHtml keeps arbitrary `class` and `data-*` attributes on user content, so a comment can reuse the app's own CSS classes (e.g. admin/status badges or account-trigger chips) to impersonate UI elements.

canCurrentUserEditPublishedComment resolves the publisher name to an address only when the current account has a name mismatch; a user whose account has no registered name (accountName empty) can still edit if the resolved address matches, but the edit will later publish under an empty name (handled in MinterBoard.js) – behaviour is inconsistent with the name-based publish path.

uxProblems.description: One shared composer per card handles new comment, edit and reply; starting a reply silently discards an in-progress edit (and vice versa) with no confirmation.
'Load all TX' warning paragraph is always shown above the controls and the buttons give no progress (count or pages loaded) while 'Loading all...' runs.
Reply previews are collapsed by default with only a small arrow icon and no visible hint of the hidden text length; the toggle button is the only affordance.
Timestamps everywhere use toLocaleString() with no relative time or timezone hint.
AT sell-order detail dumps raw creator public key and code hash into the meta grid, which is noise for most users and makes the panel very tall on phones.
Transaction flow hydration fetches registered names for both parties on every expanded row ('Loading linked names...'), so browsing a long history triggers many sequential lookups.
Edit/reply buttons are icon-only (Mobirise icon font) with title/aria-label but no visible text, and rely on inline onclick attributes rather than event delegation.
